data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is pleased to offer this brand-new 4-bedroom townhouse located in the beautiful Santorini cluster of Damac Lagoons.

Property Details:

⦁ 4 Bedrooms
⦁ Unfurnished
⦁ 4 Bathrooms
⦁ Type 4A-M Layout
⦁ Area: 1,550 SQ.FT
⦁ Landscaped Garden
⦁ Excellent Location
⦁ Brand New | Ready to Move In

This elegant townhouse is thoughtfully designed to provide both comfort and modern living. The property features spacious interiors with large windows that allow plenty of natural light throughout the home. The open-plan living and dining area seamlessly connects to the contemporary kitchen, creating a bright and welcoming space ideal for everyday living and entertaining.

Upstairs, the home offers four well-proportioned bedrooms, providing privacy and comfort for families. The landscaped garden adds a charming outdoor area where residents can relax, enjoy family time, or entertain guests. Located within the Santorini cluster at Damac Lagoons, residents enjoy a Mediterranean-inspired lifestyle surrounded by water features, lush landscaping, and a variety of leisure amenities. The community offers swimming pools, parks, walking paths, and family-friendly recreational facilities, creating a vibrant and relaxing environment to call home.
data.title: 4 bedroom townhouse to rent
